canvases.title: Fyniq · AI providers and model routes

screens.title: App shell and navigation
screens.purpose: The frame every page lives in: find any area, see what is waiting, switch Basic/Expert, theme and organisation, and reach the AI panel and Help from anywhere.
content: Header (56 px): organisation switcher 'Cognizhi Pte Ltd ▾' with logo, '⌘K Search…' field, Basic | Expert segmented control (current mode always visible), theme switch (Light, Dark, System), Help button, notification bell with unread count, avatar menu (profile, About dialog with platform version and git SHA, sign out)

Expert sidebar (240 px, collapsible to 64 px icons with tooltips): Home, Inbox (count), Sales (overdue count), Purchases (due count), Contacts, Banking (uncategorised count), Payroll (due status), Projects (over-budget count, feature-switched), Accounting (close status), Reports, Planning, Equity (ACRA tasks due, feature-switched), Compliance (due count); Settings in the footer
Basic sidebar: at most 10 items (Home, Inbox, Sales, Purchases, Contacts, Banking, Reports, Payroll and Projects when allowed, Equity shown as 'Who owns the company')
Personal section at the top for every user: My claims, My time, My shares and options, Money I put in (directors); favourites and recent items
Compact class (< 600 px; phone 390 × 844, foldable cover 344 × 882): top bar (menu, search, AI) and a bottom bar of at most five destinations: Home, Inbox, the role's main area, Banking, More

Medium class (600–1023 px; foldable unfolded 690 × 840, tablet portrait 834 × 1194): navigation rail with icons and labels; two-pane layouts split at the hinge on spanning devices, nothing placed across it
Expanded class (≥ 1024 px): full sidebar, collapsed to 64 px below 1280 px; AI panel and side-peek dock beside the content
Feature-switched items (payroll, projects, equity, AI assistant, portals) are hidden when the organisation switches them off
Badge changes announced through one polite status region as phrases ('3 approvals waiting'), never bare numbers, never moving focus
P3: multi-entity switcher in the header with an 'All entities' view where the user has access
Basic mode shows an 'Available in Expert mode' hint where a hidden area is reached from search

screens.title: Home (Today)
screens.purpose: Role-aware 'Today': what the money is doing and what needs me now, with every figure drillable to its source.
content: Pulse card (full width, the only place besides the AI panel header with the violet-to-teal gradient band): cash today (e.g. S$412,300), runway in months (or 'Not burning' when 3-month net burn ≤ 0), books health OK / review / problems with counts by severity; number ticker on first load only, none with reduced or Off motion
Needs attention: top 5 Inbox items grouped by type with status chip, amount, due date and 'Open Inbox (23)'
Stat tiles with 'last updated' and a definition on hover: burn, revenue MTD, gross margin, owed to us, we owe, GST due; undefined KPIs show '—' with the reason, never 0
Cash chart: 13 months, one series, forecast segment dashed and labelled 'Projection'; summary sentence ('Cash fell 8% in September to S$412,300') and table view
Runway shown without unconfirmed funding, saying so when the forecast includes money not yet received
Upcoming deadlines with ⏰ chips: CPF by the 14th, GST F5 one month after the period end, ECI, AIS 1 March
AI suggestions card in violet with the AI label (e.g. 'Rent for October is not yet categorised: code it to 6100?')

Likely paid (FR-BNK-16, UC-BNK-02): the pending incoming-funds signals, each 'INV-0138 likely paid: S$10,900 alert from ACME ROBOTICS' with a Lucide banknote icon and a neutral chip, never violet or the AI label (a bank's alert is not AI content), linking to the invoice; nothing is posted until the statement line is reconciled
Basic: pulse card, needs attention, four tiles (cash, burn, owed to us, we owe), deadlines. Expert: adds gross margin and GST tiles, cash chart drill to ledger lines, unrealised FX
Role variants: accountant sees close status and checks; employee sees My claims totals ('the company owes you S$27.30') and payslips; approver sees approvals waiting; board viewer sees KPIs only
states: first run (empty books, set-up checklist prompt)

screens.title: Inbox
screens.purpose: Everything waiting for me to act: approvals, AI proposals, items that cannot post, items to review, mentions and compliance tasks, triaged quickly and safely.
content: Two panes: list (40%) and detail (60%); on compact and medium screens the detail opens as a full page with a back link that restores scroll position
Group headers, each collapsible: Approvals 4, AI proposals 3, Cannot post 2 (✖), To review 6 (⚠), Mentions, Deadlines 1 (⏰), Compliance tasks, Weekly review (Founder mode)
Row: type icon, title, counterparty, amount (tabular, right-aligned), status chip with SVG icon and text, age; AI proposals carry the AI badge and a violet left rule
Filters by type and due date; link to the AI tasks page
Keyboard (Expert): J/K move, E open, A opens the approval confirmation (never approves directly), R reject with reason, ? shortcut sheet; focus never lands on Approve by default
Bulk actions only where safe: tier-1 proposals and routine documents within the self-approval limit; tier-2/3 proposals and FM-1 actions cannot be bulk-approved
Deep links from email and chat notifications open the item here (approvals never happen in chat)
Empty state: 'Nothing waiting for you.' with the last 3 decisions and undo where allowed
P2: anomaly alerts (spend 3σ above trend) and escalations of pending approvals arrive here
states: item changed by someone else (review and re-apply)

screens.title: AI proposal review
screens.purpose: Decide on a proposal the AI prepared, seeing exactly what will execute, its ledger impact and the evidence, before approving or rejecting.
content: Header: AI badge, task type name (e.g. 'Categorise bank lines', bank.categorise_lines), risk tier chip, 'proposed by AI for Anthony · 2 h ago', expiry (72 h)
Plain summary generated by platform code from the payload and dry-run impact (not model text)
Items list for batch proposals: a checkbox per item (all selected by default only for tier 1); changing the selection re-hashes the payload; 'Approve 12 of 40 categorisations'
Ledger impact: debit / credit / account table with balanced totals (Expert) or the one-line plain summary (Basic), plus balances after for affected accounts and checks that change
Diff for changed master data (before → after per field)
Evidence: links to the records and documents relied on; the AI rationale shown separately in the violet subtle style and labelled as AI text
'What could go wrong' notes for tier 2; tier 3 needs two different approvers
Sticky action bar that never covers focus: Reject (needs a reason, fed back to the AI) and Approve (names the action; step-up for tier 2-3)
After execution: resulting records, ledger entries and an 'Undo' action while the period is open

screens.title: Approval confirmation with step-up
screens.purpose: Confirm exactly what is being approved and sign it, with a passkey or TOTP step-up where the action is high-risk.
content: What you are approving: object, version, operation, selected items, amounts and currencies, payee and the version of the payee's bank details
Ledger impact and affected balances; diff against the previous version
Policy step and quorum ('Step 2 of 2 · second founder required (FM-1)'); self-approved flag below the S$2,000 threshold in Founder mode
Envelope hash shown in mono with a copy action; approvals expire after 7 days
Step-up: passkey prompt (preferred) or a TOTP field that accepts paste and password managers; no cognitive tests; error summary takes focus
Reject path with a required reason
Same dialog from the email secure link (after sign-in) and on phones as a full-screen sheet (P2 PWA)

screens.title: AI assistant panel
screens.purpose: Ask, explain and simulate in plain words from any page, with every figure cited to its source, and hand off anything that would change data as a proposal.
content: Persistent side panel (⌘J / Ctrl+J, or 'Ask about this' on any record, report or figure) carrying the page context as a chip ('Context: P&L Sep 2026')
Header with the violet-to-teal gradient band and the AI label; every AI message in violet with an 'AI' badge

Answers render figures from cited facts (measure, entity, period, currency) with citation chips that open the record, report or guide page; 'could not establish' text when a fact is missing, never a partial figure
Lanes: Ask ('What's our runway at the current burn?'), Explain (lineage of a report cell), Simulate (sandboxed scenario, 'Save as proposal'), Prepare (creates a proposal card linking to Inbox)
How-to answers cite user-guide pages from the compiled knowledge base
Expert mode also shows ledger lines, account codes and the query details behind each figure
Output limited to safe Markdown: no images or remote fetches; external URLs shown in full
Thumbs up/down with a reason; conversation history; token budget notice
Compact: opens full screen; medium: sheet over content; expanded: docked beside content
states: tool failed (says what it could not establish)

screens.title: Command palette
screens.purpose: Go anywhere, create anything and run any command from the keyboard.
content: ⌘K / Ctrl+K overlay with fuzzy search, recent items first
Groups: Go to (pages, records), Create ('new invoice for Acme'), Run report, Commands (change theme, 'Switch to Expert mode'), Help: …
Tab hands the query to the AI assistant
In Basic mode, Expert features appear with 'Available in Expert mode: switch?' as one action
Bulk actions on selected rows when opened from a grid
Shortcut hints on each command; keyboard-only navigation

screens.title: Global search results
screens.purpose: Find any document, contact, account, amount, reference or note across the organisation.
content: Query field supporting amounts ('1,234.56', '> 5k'), references ('INV-0138') and text
Type filters with counts: invoices, bills, bank lines, journals, contacts, accounts, claims, documents, help pages
Result rows with type icon, title, matched snippet, amount, date and status chip; keyboard navigation
Results, counts and snippets filtered to what the user may see; masked fields stay masked
Expert-only results offer 'Open in Expert mode'

screens.title: Notification centre
screens.purpose: See what happened (as opposed to what waits for action) and jump to the related record or Inbox item.
content: Bell panel with unread count; tabs Unread, All, Archived
Each notification: type icon, severity, the record it is about, time; actionable ones link to their Inbox item
Security notifications (new-device sign-in, MFA or role change) marked and not mutable
Mark read, mark all read, archive; link to notification preferences
Daily digest preview line when digest delivery is on

screens.title: Trace panel (drill-down)
screens.purpose: Follow any figure from a report or tile to its breakdown, the ledger lines, the source document and its history without losing place.
content: Breadcrumb trail keeping report context (P&L Sep 2026 › Software subscriptions › Ledger lines › BILL-0412)
Level 1 breakdown table; level 2 ledger lines with date, account, debit, credit, dimension values; level 3 source document preview; level 4 history from the audit trail
Ledger revision the figure was read at
Back returns to the same scroll position and filters
Side-peek over the current list; full screen on phones

screens.title: Books health and checks
screens.purpose: See every workbook and platform check with its status, understand it in plain English and fix what blocks the close.
content: Summary: books health OK / review / problems with counts of ✖, ⚠, ⏰ and ⚠ Not assessed

Grouped list by area (Books, Ledger, Banking, Purchases, Tax, Payroll, Founders, Equity, Corporate, AI, Integrations): check name, severity chip (icon + text), plain-English explanation, owner, last run
Examples: 'Debits equal credits' ✖; 'Unreconciled lines older than 30 days' ⚠; 'CPF payment due by the 14th not yet paid' ⏰; 'A director's account is in debit at a month end' ⚠
Drill-down to offending items; 'Fix it' action where possible; Not assessed names the missing input and opens the setting
Nightly ledger verification result (recomputed balances, subledgers vs control accounts, hash chain)
Basic shows the same severities with plain words only

screens.title: Banners (announcement, What's new, break-glass)
screens.purpose: Show organisation-wide and installation-wide messages under the header without hiding what the user is working on.
content: Announcement banner under the header: message, link, severity info / warning / critical; dismissible unless critical; info uses role=status, critical role=alert
Platform banners for maintenance windows and incidents
'What's new' card shown once after a release, linking to the guide
Break-glass banner on every page while active: who, reason, time left of the 24-hour expiry, 'End break-glass'
Sample company banner: 'Practice organisation: nothing here touches your real books'
Banner never covers the focused element; stacks in a fixed order when several are active

screens.title: Keyboard shortcut sheet
screens.purpose: Show every keyboard shortcut for the current page and let the user remap or turn off single-character shortcuts.
content: Opened with ?; grouped: Global (⌘K, ⌘J, G then B for Banking), Create (C I new invoice), Inbox (J/K, A, R, E), Grids (Ctrl+D fill-down, = arithmetic, undo/redo)
Basic mode shows ⌘K and ? only, with a link to switch
'Remap' and 'Turn off single-character shortcuts' controls (WCAG 2.1.4)
Note that shortcuts never fire while typing in a field

screens.title: Void and destructive-action confirmation
screens.purpose: Make the consequences of a void or other high-risk action clear before it happens, and record the reason.
content: Consequence summary: 'Voiding INV-0150 posts a reversal dated 13 Oct 2026; the original stays in history'
Reversal entries preview (Expert) or plain sentence (Basic)
Required reason field
Typed confirmation for bulk voids ('type VOID 12')
Note when the action needs a second approver (FM-1) and what happens next

screens.title: First-run walkthrough
screens.purpose: Give a new user a short, skippable spotlight tour of the real interface.
content: Spotlight on each element with a short caption and step counter (at most 7 steps, about 2 minutes): Basic/Expert toggle, Home, Inbox and approving, recording money in and out, ⌘K search, the AI panel, Help
Next, Back, Skip at every step; Esc closes; focus moves to the step and back to where it started
Role variants (founder or owner, accountant, employee, approver, board viewer)
Steps whose target is hidden at the current breakpoint or mode are skipped
With reduced motion or organisation motion Off: same steps, no movement
Feature tip variant (1-3 steps) the first time a feature is opened

screens.title: Help and user guide
screens.purpose: Learn the whole product where you are: tasks, concepts, Singapore guides, shortcuts, the glossary and What's new.
content: Left column (sticky): search, table of contents (Getting started, tasks, concepts, Singapore guides, keyboard shortcuts, glossary, What's new) and 'Take the tour again'

Page (max 880 px): title, one-sentence purpose, numbered steps ('How do I record a bill?'), 'Good to know', Recommended default callout, Check first callout for [verify] items, related pages, version and last update
Opens on the page mapped to the current route (Banking → Recording money)
Screenshots from end-to-end tests in light and dark
What's new: release entries newest first with version and date
'Try it in the sample company' action
Info popover pattern shown on a field: what it is, why it matters, example, Learn more
Below 1024 px the contents stack above the page, search first; Help panel variant as a side sheet

screens.title: Guided set-up checklist
screens.purpose: Set the organisation up step by step, or explore safely in the sample company first.
content: Checklist with progress (e.g. 4 of 8): company, financial year, GST, bank accounts, opening balances, contacts, employees, import from the workbook
Each step shows status, the recommended defaults it applies ('Recommended' or 'Changed from recommended') and a link to the guide
'Explore the sample company' card opening a separate, clearly labelled organisation
'What happened → where to record it' helper: pick an event (customer paid, bought a laptop, founder paid a cost) and go to the right screen
Target: first-time set-up from the workbook in 60 minutes or less

screens.title: Invoices list
screens.purpose: See and work every sales invoice by its approval, delivery, settlement and due state.
content: Tabs: Invoices, Credit notes, Receipts; saved views and a 'needs attention' view (overdue, bounced, cannot post)
Columns: number (mono), customer, date, due date, amount, amount due, currency, state chips (approval, ledger, delivery, settlement, due)
Summary strip: overdue S$ and count, awaiting approval, drafts
Basic: simple table with key columns; Expert: full grid with column chooser, multi-sort, bulk send or post, export
Side-peek opens a record without losing place
Teaching empty state: 'Invoices you send appear here' with 'Create your first invoice'
Compact: rows become cards with amount, customer and the most urgent chip

screens.title: Invoice editor
screens.purpose: Create or edit an invoice, quote or credit note with the IRAS particulars right, and preview its ledger impact before saving.
content: Basic guided form: customer, date, amount or lines with description, category, GST code suggested (SR 9%), attachment; plain words
Expert lines grid: item, description, quantity, unit price, discount %, account, GST code, dimensions, service period (deferred revenue); paste from Excel, = arithmetic
Currency and rate with source; for foreign-currency invoices net, GST and gross shown in SGD
Terms and due date, deposit or retainer to apply, notes, template choice, attachments
Totals panel with GST summary and the ledger impact preview (dry run)
'Has advanced details (2)' disclosure in Basic when the record uses Expert fields, with 'Open in Expert mode'
Created from a quote, order or timesheets keeps the link; switching mode keeps every entered value
Credit note variant: pick the invoice and lines to credit (full or partial) or standalone
states: validation errors (✖ cannot post, plain words with field links)

screens.title: Invoice record (also quote, credit note)
screens.purpose: Everything about one sales document: its states, what it posted, who saw and paid it, and what to do next.
content: Header: INV-0150, customer, total S$5,450.00, amount due, separate state chips (approval, ledger, delivery: sent / opened / bounced, settlement: open / part-paid / paid / written off, due), primary actions Approve, Post, Send, Record payment, ⋯

Tabs: Details · Lines · Ledger impact (open for accountants; collapsed plain summary in Basic) · Attachments · Activity (history, approvals, comments, @mentions) · Related (receipts, allocations, credit notes, source quote)
Right panel: checks for this record, AI suggestions (violet), evidence
Send status timeline: sent, opened, accepted (quotes), paid; secure online link; PayNow QR or payment link (P2)
Peppol transmission status up to the IRAS acknowledgement ID (P2)
Disputed amount and promise-to-pay date pausing reminders (P2)
Quote variant: validity date, status Draft/Sent/Accepted/Declined/Invoiced/Expired, customer acceptance evidence (name, date, comment), 'Convert to invoice'
Provider-billed (Model B) variant: read-only mirror with the provider's collection attempts and next retry date

screens.title: Quotes and orders
screens.purpose: Track quotes and sales orders through to invoice and see the pipeline value.
content: Pipeline value by status (Draft, Sent, Accepted, Declined, Invoiced, Cancelled, Expired)
Rows: number, customer, date, validity date, amount, status chip, opened or accepted online
Expiring-soon filter with scheduled reminders
Bulk convert accepted quotes to invoices (full or partial)

screens.title: Record payment and allocate
screens.purpose: Apply a receipt, credit note or deposit to one or more documents and deal with any residual properly.
content: Receipt amount, date, money account, currency and rate
Allocation table: open documents with amount in document currency and in base, realised FX per allocation

Residual handling: within tolerance clears to 7030; larger keeps the document part-paid unless a reason-coded write-off is chosen (agreed discount, bank or provider charges, bad debt, cross-currency difference) which needs approval and evidence
Overpayment above S$1.00 stays as a customer credit (never income)
Undo allocation creates a reversing allocation
Same dialog mirrored for bills (supplier credits and refunds)

screens.title: Recurring invoices and bills
screens.purpose: Set up and monitor documents that repeat on a schedule.
content: Templates with frequency (weekly to yearly), next run date, auto-draft or auto-send, month-end handling, amount, contact
Run history with the documents created and any failures (scheduler ⚠)
Pause, resume, edit (new version)
AI-proposed templates (recur.create_template) shown with the AI badge until approved

screens.title: Customer statements and reminders
screens.purpose: Send statements of account and keep overdue invoices chased on a schedule.
content: Statement builder: customer, date range; brought-forward balance, documents, payments, FX and rounding, ageing that adds to the balance; preview and send
Reminder schedules per customer group with templates (e.g. 7 days before, on due date, 14 days after)
Reminder queue with paused items (disputed, promise-to-pay; P2)
AI-drafted reminder emails (ar.draft_reminders) sent only after approval

screens.title: Items (products and services)
screens.purpose: Maintain the products and services used on invoices.
content: Columns: code, name, type, unit, price per currency, revenue account, GST code, active flag, FY quantity and sales
Item side-peek with printed description and price history
P3: price lists per customer group or currency

screens.title: Subscriptions and contracts
screens.purpose: See subscriptions mirrored from Stripe Billing or HitPay, and (P2) Fyniq's own subscription schedules and amendments.
content: Rows: customer, plan (e.g. S$49 a month), provider, status (active, past due, unpaid, cancelled, paused), service period, next invoice, collection attempts
Read-only mirror badge for provider-billed (Model B) subscriptions
Parked items with ⚠ for the accountant (usage prices, trials with add-ons)
P2: contract amendments (upgrade, downgrade, cancel) with dated schedule changes and evidence
Booked MRR vs contracted MRR, each named

screens.title: Bills board and calendar
screens.purpose: Track every bill from capture to payment and plan what to pay when.
content: Board columns: To review, Awaiting approval, Approved, Scheduled, Paid, Overdue; card shows supplier, number, amount, due date, chips
Calendar view by due date with scheduled payment dates; drag (or keyboard 'Schedule for…') a bill to a payment date
List view toggle; AP ageing summary; cash requirement for the next 30 days
Early-payment discounts shown; reminders before due dates
Compact: board becomes a status filter with a card list

screens.title: Bill editor with document capture
screens.purpose: Record a supplier bill in minutes, from a captured document or by hand, with input tax decided from the facts.
content: Split view: document preview (left) and the draft (right); low-confidence extracted fields highlighted
Fields: supplier (UEN, GST registration number), number, dates, currency, lines with expense or asset account, GST code (TX, BL…), dimensions, prepayment spread over months
Input-tax eligibility per line with the deciding condition (claimable, not claimable, ⚠ for the tax agent); 'no SGD GST stated' warning

Input tax card (rev 0.89): what the claim rests on (tax invoice, simplified tax invoice, import permit, none), supplier GST-registered, addressed to the company or an agent (paid back, or credited to a director's loan), the tax agent's decision when a line is left to them; each line's business share (%)
Supplier defaults suggested from approved bills; duplicate blocked (supplier, number, amount, date window)
Non-resident supplier: nature of payment and the tax agent's withholding decision; ⚠ until decided
Basic: plain summary 'This bill adds S$1,090 to what we owe ABC'; Expert: ledger impact with codes
Capitalisation threshold prompt to create a fixed asset
Costs from before incorporation or GST registration keep their original date and are flagged for the accountant

screens.title: Bill record (also vendor credit)
screens.purpose: Review, approve, schedule and pay one bill and see what it posted.
content: Header: supplier, BILL number, total, separate state chips (approval, ledger, payment: unscheduled / in a batch / paid / written off, due), actions Approve, Schedule payment, Record payment, ⋯
Tabs: Details, Lines, Ledger impact, Attachments, Activity, Related (payment batch, PO, supplier contract, credits)
Right panel: checks (possible duplicate, vendor bank details changed in the last 30 days), AI suggestions, evidence (receipt or invoice required)
Remittance advice sent status
Vendor credit variant: apply to bills or refund
Clearance hold notice when the payee is under an IR21 hold

screens.title: Purchase orders
screens.purpose: Raise and approve purchase orders and convert them to bills.
content: List: PO number, supplier, project, amount, status (draft, awaiting approval, approved, billed, closed)
PO record uses the document anatomy with lines and approval; 'Convert to bill'
P2: three-way match status (PO, receipt, bill)

screens.title: Supplier contracts and renewals
screens.purpose: Never miss a cancellation deadline on software, cloud and service commitments.
content: Register: supplier, owner, start and end dates, renewal type, notice deadline (often well before renewal), billing frequency, amount and currency, minimum commitment
Timeline of notice deadlines with reminders at 30 and 7 days
Contract evidence and links to POs, recurring bills and bills
Note: commitments are shown, not booked

screens.title: Contacts list
screens.purpose: One list of customers, vendors and investors with their live balances.
content: Role filter chips: Customer, Vendor, Both, Investor, Shareholder
Columns: name, UEN or tax ID, owed to us, we owe, overdue, last activity, Peppol ID
Possible duplicate flag (name, UEN, email, bank account) with merge review
Pending bank-detail change chip on vendors

screens.title: Contact record
screens.purpose: Everything about one customer or supplier: details, balances, ageing, activity and payment details.
content: Header: name, roles, owed to us / we owe, FY sales and spend

Tabs: Details (legal name, UEN, Peppol ID, billing and remittance emails, terms, currency, default category and GST code, tax residence), Documents, Ageing, Activity timeline (sent, opened, paid), Bank details, Unapplied credits
Bank details shown masked with 'Change bank details' (dual-controlled) and change history
Withholding-tax decisions by nature of payment for non-resident suppliers
P2: vendor statement reconciliation

screens.title: Change payee bank details
screens.purpose: Change a supplier's bank details safely: evidence, second approver and a payment freeze until approved.
content: Old (masked) and new account details
Required evidence: bank letter or screenshot of confirmation through a known channel; recommended call-back note (who, when, number used)
Warning: payments to this vendor freeze until approved; batches approved before the change need re-approval
Second approver selection; all founders notified; step-up on submit
P2: payee name check result from the bank

screens.title: Bank accounts and cash position
screens.purpose: See every money account, how fresh its data is and what still needs categorising.
content: Cash position across accounts and currencies at the latest rates (base SGD total)

Account cards: bank, card, wallet, payment-gateway and cash accounts (DBS current, Wise USD, Airwallex, Stripe clearing), balance, uncategorised count, last sync, 'complete to' date, sync source (file, email report, API)
Stale or broken sync ⚠ with the gap ('No statement since 9 Oct')
Actions: Categorise, Import statement, Reconcile, Add account

screens.title: Add a bank account and data source
screens.purpose: Create a money account and choose how its data arrives, without credential-sharing aggregators.
content: Step 1: account type, bank, currency, ledger account code, opening balance date

Step 2: data source: file import (CSV, MT940, camt.053, OFX), bank reports by email (shows the organisation's bank-ingest address for DBS IDEAL daily reports and incoming-funds alerts), EMI API (Wise, Airwallex read-only key), bank API or host-to-host (P2)
Step 3: test and first sync; continuity check result
Explainer: connectors are read-only; payments go out as approved files

screens.title: Bank account register
screens.purpose: Review one account's statement lines, their status and any gaps or duplicates.
content: Statement lines: booking and value dates, description (mono, untrusted text), counterparty, amount, running balance, status (reconciled, auto-reconciled, pending, suspense ⚠, possible duplicate ⚠)
Continuity bar per statement (opening = previous closing; MT940 :60F: / :62F:) with gaps flagged
Incoming-funds alerts shown as pending signals, not reconciled lines
Transfers in transit and transfers matched on both sides
Resolve 'possible duplicate' with a side-by-side compare

screens.title: Statement import
screens.purpose: Bring in statements for several accounts at once and see exactly what will be added.
content: Drop several files (CSV, XLSX, OFX/QFX, camt.053, MT940); each assigned to an account
Column mapping per bank (signed amount or in/out columns), saved for next time
Preview: lines to add, duplicates removed (same bank reference), possible duplicates kept for review, continuity check
Commit with a result per file; malware scan and safe-file checks
P2: PDF statements via document AI

screens.title: Categorise, one line at a time (Basic)
screens.purpose: Clear the bank queue one line at a time by accepting or changing a suggestion.
content: Card per line: date, description (plain text), amount ('Money in S$10,900.00')
Suggestions in order: matching invoice or bill (INV-0138, ACME ROBOTICS), rule hit, AI suggestion (violet with AI badge)
Accept (one click), Change (short form: category, contact, GST code), Skip
Progress '12 of 40 done'
Duplicates and mirrored transfers flagged ⚠ with an explanation; contextual hint 'You can split this line in Expert mode'
Accepting a batch of AI suggestions creates a tier-1 proposal to approve

screens.title: Categorise and match grid (Expert)
screens.purpose: Work the unreconciled queue in bulk: categorise, split, transfer and match payments to documents.
content: Grid: date, description, amount, suggested category, contact, GST code, dimensions, status chip; range selection, paste, Ctrl+D fill-down, bulk accept selection
Split view for matching: bank line left, candidate invoices and bills right with amount difference and tolerance; one payment to many documents and many to one
Actions: split line, mark as transfer (matched on both sides), post to suspense 2999 ⚠
Rules editor opens in a side-peek with back-test
